_comment: Curated local-model catalog for ItsJustCAD's Model Setup. VERIFIED entries were checked against the live HuggingFace repo (URL 200s, size = Content-Length, sha256 = the git-LFS `oid sha256:` from the /raw/ pointer file). To add/refresh an entry: GET https://huggingface.co/<repo>/raw/main/<file> and copy the oid + size. `tier` gates the UI recommendation; `ram_gb_min` gates the Install button. `runtime` selects how the next agent spawns it (gguf => llama.cpp server; llamafile => the self-contained binary).
